item.murimblock.qi_gathering_pill.toolti: Raises Qi Max and fills the reserve
item.murimblock.realm_breaking_pill.tool: Weakens the Heart Demon of your next great breakthrough (10 min)
item.murimblock.pill.toxicity: Adds toxicity: too many pills poison
cultivation.murimblock.bottleneck: Your Qi presses against the gate of %s. Meditate with a full reserve and hold [%s] for fifteen seconds: in your inner world, the old master will offer you the trial
cultivation.murimblock.deviation: Your Qi deviates: Qi Max lost, the reserve gone, your body weakened for a while
cultivation.murimblock.inner.reserve: Your reserve must be full to open your inner world
cultivation.murimblock.inner.arrived: You open your eyes in your inner world. Speak to the remnant soul; hold the meditation key to return
cultivation.murimblock.inner.demon: Your Heart Demon rises: all your strength, your art, your blood. Its blows weigh %s%%. Defeat it to break through; it wins, and your Qi deviates
cultivation.murimblock.inner.gate: Your Qi presses against the gate of your realm. The old master is waiting for you
cultivation.murimblock.inner.demon_slain: Your Heart Demon dissolves. The gate opens...
cultivation.murimblock.inner.torn_out: Your body was struck: you are torn out of your inner world
cultivation.murimblock.pill.poisoned: Too much toxicity: the pill poisons you
cultivation.murimblock.pill.breaking: Your next Heart Demon will be weaker (toxicity %s)
cultivation.murimblock.soul.busy.storm: Remnant Soul: "The scattered Qi will not wait. Gather it."
cultivation.murimblock.soul.busy.sparrin: Remnant Soul: "Your shadow is waiting for you."
cultivation.murimblock.soul.tomorrow: Remnant Soul: "Enough for today. Rest, and come back tomorrow."
cultivation.murimblock.soul.start.storm: Mission: gather the scattered Qi within a minute (+%s Qi Max)
cultivation.murimblock.soul.start.sparri: Mission: beat your shadow (+%s Qi Max)
cultivation.murimblock.soul.done.storm: Remnant Soul: "Good. Your Qi is whole again." +%s Qi Max
cultivation.murimblock.soul.done.sparrin: Remnant Soul: "You beat yourself. Remember how." +%s Qi Max
cultivation.murimblock.soul.lost.storm: Remnant Soul: "Too slow: %s of %s. Tomorrow, perhaps."
cultivation.murimblock.soul.lost.sparrin: Remnant Soul: "Your shadow won. Rest, then try again."
dialogue.murimblock.soul.first: So... you finally opened your eyes in here. Do not be afraid, child. I have dwelt in your dantian since long before you knew you had one.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.greet: You came back. Good. %s %s... Your Qi is steadier than last time. What do you seek?
dialogue.murimblock.soul.menu: What else do you wish to know?
dialogue.murimblock.soul.who: Once I had a name, a sect and a sword. Now I am only what remains of a master who reached too far. You may call me Sensei.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.past: At the gate of a great realm, my Heart Demon rose. It had my strength, my art, every trick I knew. I hesitated; it did not. My Qi tore my body apart, and this remnant fled into you.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.where: Your inner world. This island is your dantian made visible: it grows as you grow, and it bears the marks of your art and of your failures.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.farewell: Go. And do not neglect your breathing.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.train.storm: Your Qi lies scattered over the island like leaves after a storm. Gather every mote within a minute. (+%s Qi Max)
dialogue.murimblock.soul.train.sparring: Spar with your shadow. It is only half of you, but it fights the way you do. Learn your own habits. (+%s Qi Max)
dialogue.murimblock.soul.train.none: Enough for today. Qi gathered in haste scatters. Rest, and come back tomorrow.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.train.gate: Your Qi can grow no more in this realm. Only the gate is left.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.begin.storm: Go. Before the wind takes them.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.begin.sparring: Face it. And watch what it does better than you.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.busy.storm: The scattered Qi will not wait for you.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.busy.sparring: Your shadow is waiting. Do not keep it waiting.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.resume: Then stop talking to an old ghost.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.given_up: Hm. Nothing gained, nothing lost. Try again when your mind is clear.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.advice.toxic: Your meridians reek of pills. Elixirs force the Qi in; they do not make it yours. Let them clear before you take another.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.advice.place: Your body sits where the Qi runs thin. Meditate in the Murim lands, on a high peak, or near the sanctuary of the Cloud Cliff, and it will gather far faster.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.advice.gate: A new realm draws near. When your Qi presses against its gate, come to me: there is a trial no one passes unprepared.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.advice.roads: Three roads lead up. Sit and condense your Qi every day. Spend it in battle, for Qi that is used grows. And swallow elixirs, sparingly.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.gate: Your Qi presses against the walls of %s. I felt it the moment you arrived.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.gate.again: The walls of %s will not hold your Qi much longer.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.beyond: Beyond lies %s. But no one passes that gate untested. It is guarded by the one who knows you best: yourself.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.myself: Your Heart Demon. It will have your blood, your strength, your art, every move you know. Not a hair less. Only your heart can differ.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.prepare: Its strength is yours, but its blows land as hard as your doubts. Meditate in a place of power, take a Realm-Breaking Pill, carry no poison. As you are today, its blows would land at %s%% of their weight.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.warn: Once it rises, there is no walking away. Flee, and your Qi turns on you. Fall, and it scatters. Are you certain?
dialogue.murimblock.soul.trial.now: Do not look at me. Look at it!
dialogue.murimblock.soul.not_yet: Wise. The gate will not move. Come back when your heart is still.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.answer.resume: I am going back to it.
dialogue.murimblock.soul.answer.ready: I am ready to face myself.

message.murimblock.sensei.challenge: Sensei Yun: "The Azure Cloud is not given, it is earned. Draw your blade and take it from me, if you can."
message.murimblock.sensei.second_phase: Sensei Yun: "Enough courtesy. Now, see the Azure Cloud."
technique.murimblock.cast.not_in_combat: Enter combat mode to use your techniques
technique.murimblock.swallow_returns.dis: A swallow returns to its nest... You discovered the secret technique Swallow Returns
technique.murimblock.cloud_step_slash.de: Hold the key to aim in the draw stance, let go to dash 5 blocks through everything on the way. In the air: a dive that knocks down. As a riposte: a short dash that cuts twice.
technique.murimblock.thousand_drizzle.de: Within 3 blocks: six cuts that hold, a last one that sends flying, then every cut opens again on the body. Farther: a great ghost sword sent straight ahead. As a riposte: the last cut breaks the guard.
technique.murimblock.heaven_splitting_cr: A rising cut: you leap 7 blocks, carrying the target. Hang there 1.5 s, then press again to slam it down: the landing blasts the ground. Needs open sky. In the air: Cloud-Splitting Descent.
technique.murimblock.swallow_returns.des: Cloud Step Slash within a quarter second of a perfect parry: you appear behind the attacker and spin into a cut.
Strikes that land restore 1 Qi. A perfect parry restores 6 Qi and opens a riposte: for 1.5 s, your next technique takes its riposte form for half its Qi.
strike.murimblock.piercing_mist.desc: a long thrust with a step
strike.murimblock.rising_cloud.desc: launcher: a rising cut that lifts
strike.murimblock.falling_rain.desc: finisher: a falling cut that knocks down
strike.murimblock.wind_step.desc: a sliding step with a cut
quest.murimblock.step.patient_blade.dash: Enemies cut by Cloud Step Slash %s/%s
quest.murimblock.step.sea_of_clouds.bell: Ring the bell of the sanctuary %s/%s
passive.murimblock.crimson_stance.desc: Bare-hand crimson strikes and guard. Landed M1 strikes build the blood gauge, then earn dorsal crystals while transformed.
technique.murimblock.bloodbane_drain.des: Hold to grow a blood crystal in your hand, its fragments circling it. Held longer, it draws your blood gauge into itself and grows; at a full gauge it becomes a great crystal that explodes. Release to throw it. It can be guarded or parried.
technique.murimblock.scarlet_tear.desc: A blood sword forms in your hand, piece by piece, and you fight with it as with any sword; no other technique while it is out. Press again to throw it like a javelin, point first: it explodes where it strikes. A landed throw builds 3 points toward Blood Crystal Form.
Activate at a full blood gauge. Lasts 30 seconds, in or out of combat, and reduces incoming damage by 30%. Land M1 strikes to earn up to 10 dorsal crystals.
technique.murimblock.tiger_step_punch.de: A low bound of 3 blocks ending in a punch that pushes back a block. In the air: a dive with a punch to the ground that knocks down.
technique.murimblock.rapid_fists.desc: Five quick punches that hold the target, then one that sends it 3 blocks back. In the air: three punches, then a hammer fist that knocks it down.
technique.murimblock.whirlwind_kick.desc: A spinning jump, leg stretched, that strikes all round you (2.5 blocks) and pushes back 3 blocks. In the air: you come down turning and strike all round as you land.
technique.murimblock.inch_force.desc: Tiger Step Punch with the target already at your fist, within a second of a perfect parry: no bound, one punch from where you stand. Everything stops a moment, then the target flies 6 blocks and stays stunned.
technique.murimblock.inch_force.discover: Power needs no distance... You discovered the secret technique Inch Force
passive.murimblock.steady_breath.desc: Bare-handed, your punches that land restore 1 Qi, and a perfect parry restores 5 Qi. Your guard holds without a weapon.
quest.murimblock.step.first_steps.tiger_: Enemies hit by Tiger Step Punch %s/%s
quest.murimblock.step.unbroken_flurry.fu: Full flurries of Rapid Fists on an enemy %s/%s
gui.murimblock.techniques.strikes_hint: Click a strike to change it
gui.murimblock.techniques.strikes_bare_h: Your own bare-hand strikes: three punches, a running punch and a strike in the air. Nothing to choose here.
gui.murimblock.techniques.library_hint: The martial arts you have learned. Open one to read its techniques: a technique shows only once you have unlocked it.
gui.murimblock.techniques.secret_hint: A secret of this art: it shows itself only once you find it in combat.

qi.murimblock.death_penalty: Death costs you %s Qi Max (now %s); never below the stage you reached
knockdown.murimblock.downed: You are down! Crawl away, or wait to get up
knockdown.murimblock.recovered: You get back on your feet
technique.murimblock.crystal_barrage.des: Launch every earned dorsal crystal at your aim. Consumes the crystals while keeping Blood Crystal Form active.
technique.murimblock.blood_iceberg.desc: Strike the ground: an arena of blood crystal, 45 blocks across, rises under you, walled and spired, and lifts everyone on it onto its floor. In it you have Strength and Regeneration, and a blood crystal grows back every 3 seconds. It crumbles after 60 seconds. Recovers in 9 minutes.
quest.murimblock.step.crimson_peak.forms: Hold Blood Crystal Form to its end: %s/%s
quest.murimblock.step.crystal_mastery.hi: Land M1 strikes in Blood Crystal Form: %s/%s
death.attack.blood_crystal.item: %1$s was pierced by %2$s's blood crystal using %3$s
